questions.title: 1. Which brand or specific product should we research? Brand traits or a signature-product clue also work.
2. Which country or market are you targeting? Multiple countries or representative global markets are allowed.
3. How many competitors? Excludes your brand; total across all selected markets unless you specify otherwise.
4. Any competitors that must be included? You may enter brand or product names.
5. Which comparison dimensions? You may enter X, Y and additional dimensions.
6. Who is the audience, or what is the research objective?
options: No specific audience or objective yet

questions.title: 7. Any official site, product link or additional characteristics?
8. Choose research depth. Quick covers the selected scope; In-depth adds corroboration and market detail.
